patch_description:
This replaces shallow sampled expectimax with a particle-based model-predictive controller. For every possible current tilt, it runs multiple common-random-number future simulations. Each simulation inserts several upcoming known flavors at random legal cells, then uses a fast greedy rollout policy to choose future tilts. The current direction is selected by the average terminal quality across particles.

The board representation is compact and avoids rebuilding candy vectors. Evaluation combines exact same-flavor component-square value, adjacency, flavor compactness, and a fading strip-separation prior. The auxiliary terms disappear toward the end, so late decisions increasingly optimize the official connectivity objective directly.
